Name: Everyone Likes Fruit
Author: swiftishere1
Description:
[center]Ever thought it was weird how vegetables are a universal like, but fruit isn't? This mod changes that! Now everyone appreciates the fine taste of nature's candy (and will gladly take that plum you just grabbed off the ground). Happy gifting!

Note: This mod does not override gift tastes associated with [i]specific[/i] fruit - so Maru will still dislike Salmonberry, etc. as I assumed these were specific tastes to the character, and not them arbitrarily disliking all fruit. It also has not been tested extensively and may conflict with other mods that edit gift tastes. [/center]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Everyone Likes Fruit
Manifest.Description: Changes fruit to a universal like.
